sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Assessment_Notes"."teacher_id" AS e, "Teachers"."gender" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Assessment_Notes" JOIN "Teachers" ON "Teachers"."teacher_id" = "Assessment_Notes"."teacher_id"  GROUP BY "Assessment_Notes"."teacher_id", "Teachers"."gender"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of Assessment_Notes records (all level)
rank within the group by number of Assessment_Notes records: share of the all total, keep the top 3
